# AI data centers are scaling fast. Let's build them the right way.

Water is at the heart of AI. You need water to produce chips, to power them, and to cool them. There
is no AI without water. And today, that matters more than ever.

[Read More][7][Watch Our Experts][8]

## We partner to make the world cleaner, safer and healthier - helping customers succeed while
## protecting people and the resources vital to life.

People Health

Helping people thrive by protecting their individual health, the food they eat and the spaces where
they live and work.

Planet Health

Helping the planet thrive by protecting the earth's climate and its most valuable resource: water.

Business Health

Helping businesses thrive by protecting their reputations and their bottom line.

[Get to Know Ecolab][9]

## We can help you measure – and reach – your goals.

eROI is the exponential return on investment that comes from improved performance, operational
efficiency and sustainable impact. By tracking Total Value Delivered of Ecolab solutions, our
customers see how they are achieving their sustainability and business goals together. Interact with
our eROI counter to see how much water, energy, waste and air is positively impacted by customers
using our technologies.
[Learn More About eROI][10]

perspectives to inspire cities around the world.

perspectives to inspire cities around the world.

Ramboll is a global engineering, architecture and consultancy company with more than 18,000 experts
that create sustainable solutions for governments and companies all over the world.

We combine insights with the power to drive positive change to our clients, in the form of ideas
that can be realised and implemented.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

# BINDER simulation chambers.
# Always the right conditions.

At BINDER, we create **best conditions for your success** with climate chambers and incubators
engineered and manufactured in Germany and trusted by scientific and industrial laboratories around
the world.

Our mission is to make a meaningful technical contribution to human health and safety while
protecting the environment. That’s why sustainability, accuracy and long-term value are central to
every product we create - so you can focus fully on what drives you: research and development that
shapes our future.

## Worldwide trust in BINDER

From research labs to high-tech industries: BINDER chambers prove themselves every day. These
selected case studies show how reliably and efficiently our solutions help customers meet tough
challenges.

# CECO Environmental – We Help Protect Our Shared Environment

## How can we help?

[LEARN MORE ABOUT CECO ESG][43]
 

## In Focus

[ [Leading industrial water and wastewater management image] ][44]

### [Leading industrial water and wastewater management][45]

Get to know CECO Industrial Water! Our innovative, sustainable approach spans 40+ countries,
supported by brands like Peerless, Kemco Systems, and more. We provide comprehensive services from
planning to installation, ensuring exceptional water quality and environmental protection.

[Learn More][46]
[ [EV Battery Market image] ][47]

### [EV Battery Market][48]

CECO Environmental brands deliver tailored emissions control solutions for the lithium battery
industry, addressing regional needs across the entire lifecycle—from mining and processing to
manufacturing and recycling. Their advanced technologies, including Dust Collectors, Scrubbers, and
Regenerative Thermal Oxidizers (RTOs), are designed to meet local regulatory standards while
effectively managing emissions such as particulate matter, VOCs, and hazardous air pollutants.

[Learn More][49]
[ [Eliminate Corrosion in Marine Environments image] ][50]

### [Eliminate Corrosion in Marine Environments][51]

Peerless composite louvers are designed to combat corrosion in marine environments, offering a
durable and cost-effective alternative to traditional steel louvers. Made from fiber-reinforced
plastic (FRP) composite materials, these louvers eliminate corrosion issues, reduce maintenance
needs, and provide long-term savings. They are lightweight, UV-resistant, and thermally stable,
making them ideal for harsh maritime conditions. Additionally, their advanced design incorporates
radar-absorbing stealth technology for military applications.

[Learn More][52]
[ [Regenerative Thermal Oxidizer image] ][53]

### [Regenerative Thermal Oxidizer][54]

Adwest, EIS, and WK brands deliver cutting-edge air pollution control solutions, specializing in
Regenerative Thermal Oxidizers (RTOs) to meet the environmental needs of industries worldwide. RTOs
effectively reduce volatile organic compounds (VOCs), hazardous air pollutants (HAPs), and odors by
oxidizing them at high temperatures into harmless byproducts like carbon dioxide and water.

[Learn More][55]
[ [Hee-duall Bio-pro Biofiltration Landing Page image] ][56]

### [Hee-duall Bio-pro Biofiltration Landing Page][57]

Hee-Duall Bio-Pro biofiltration systems are designed to protect the environment and people from
harmful pollutants like corrosive gases, hazardous air pollutants, and odors. The system
incorporates green technology that reduces NOx and CO2 emissions, eliminates the use of fossil
fuels, and optimizes energy and water efficiency. They offer a low total cost of ownership by
providing cost-effective solutions with long equipment life, efficiency, and preventive maintenance
programs. These biofiltration systems are reliable, efficient, and environmentally friendly.

[Learn More][58]
[ [Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) image] ][59]

### [Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS)][60]

Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) stands at the forefront of global efforts to combat
the climate crisis. By capturing CO₂ emissions from industrial processes and either utilizing them
in practical applications or storing them securely underground, CCUS technologies offer a scalable
solution to reduce greenhouse gas emissions drastically.

[Learn More][61]

manufacturing and recycling. Their advanced technologies, including Dust Collectors, Scrubbers, and

durable and cost-effective alternative to traditional steel louvers. Made from fiber-reinforced
plastic (FRP) composite materials, these louvers eliminate corrosion issues, reduce maintenance
needs, and provide long-term savings. They are lightweight, UV-resistant, and thermally stable,
making them ideal for harsh maritime conditions. Additionally, their advanced design incorporates
radar-absorbing stealth technology for military applications.

Regenerative Thermal Oxidizers (RTOs) to meet the environmental needs of industries worldwide. RTOs
effectively reduce volatile organic compounds (VOCs), hazardous air pollutants (HAPs), and odors by
oxidizing them at high temperatures into harmless byproducts like carbon dioxide and water.

### 清潔生產伙伴計劃簡介

2008年4月，香港特別行政區(香港特區)政府環境保護署(環保署)聯同當時的廣東省經濟和信息化委員會(現稱廣東
省工業和信息化廳)，
開展清潔生產伙伴計劃(本計劃)，協助位於香港及廣東省的港資工廠採用清潔生產技術和作業方式。

為配合國家提出加快經濟社會發展全面綠色轉型的重要方向，及鑑於伙伴計劃所帶來的環境效益，香港特區政府再
投入港幣1億元，延展伙伴計劃兩年至2027年6月30日。香港生產力促進局(生產力局)繼續為本計劃的執行機構及擔
任本計劃秘書處。

##### 已更新清潔生產新技術名單

清潔生產新技術項目技術名單內下列技術的5個獲批配額已滿，因此本計劃不再接受有關技術的資助申請

第8項技術 - 採用低氮燃燒器以減少空氣污染物排放
第24項技術 - 採用數碼印刷機以減少揮發性有機化合物排放
第46項技術 - 採用蒸發式冷凝器及預冷蒸發器雙效聯動技術以節約能源
第70項技術 - 採用激光直接成像曝光機以減少產生固體廢物
可獲資助的清潔生產新技術名單已經更新，請[到此][32]查閱。
請[按此][33]下載清潔生產新技術項目申請表。

##### 新一輪清潔生產伙伴計劃現已接受申請！

資助額可高達港幣750,000元，詳情請按[此處][34]查看。

### 清潔生產伙伴計劃簡介

2008年4月，香港特別行政區(香港特區)政府環境保護署(環保署)聯同當時的廣東省經濟和信息化委員會(現稱廣東
省工業和信息化廳)，
開展清潔生產伙伴計劃(本計劃)，協助位於香港及廣東省的港資工廠採用清潔生產技術和作業方式。

為配合國家提出加快經濟社會發展全面綠色轉型的重要方向，及鑑於伙伴計劃所帶來的環境效益，香港特區政府再
投入港幣1億元，延展伙伴計劃兩年至2027年6月30日。香港生產力促進局(生產力局)繼續為本計劃的執行機構及擔
任本計劃秘書處。

## We may already have the answers to your question.

What is job scheduling software?

Job scheduling software is a tool designed to streamline the process of planning and managing tasks
and appointments. It allows businesses to allocate resources efficiently.

How does job scheduling software improve efficiency?

It optimizes routes, matches skills to jobs, reduces travel time, and provides real-time visibility.

What features should I look for in job scheduling software?

Look for drag-and-drop calendars, skill filtering, route optimization, mobile access, and real-time
updates.

Can job scheduling software integrate with other tools?

 Yes, Commusoft integrates with accounting, payments, and communication tools for a seamless
workflow.

What is job scheduling software?

Job scheduling software is a tool designed to streamline the process of planning and managing tasks
and appointments. It allows businesses to allocate resources efficiently.

How does job scheduling software improve efficiency?

It optimizes routes, matches skills to jobs, reduces travel time, and provides real-time visibility.

What features should I look for in job scheduling software?

Look for drag-and-drop calendars, skill filtering, route optimization, mobile access, and real-time
updates.

Can job scheduling software integrate with other tools?

workflow.

How do I pay for Indonesian company reports?
Search for a company, add reports to your cart, proceed to checkout, and pay securely by credit

Most reports are delivered within one business day. The expected delivery time is displayed at

What if I cannot find an Indonesian company?

Why haven't I received the report I ordered?

How do I remove my company from Companies House Indonesia?
We don’t manually add or remove records. Data is synced with official registries.

[ Afghanistan floods again as communities struggle to recover ][86]
Flash floods that began on 20 July 2026 have struck nine provinces across Afghanistan, with Nuristan
bearing the brunt of the devastation, according to a press release by the International Organization
for Migration (IOM). Homes, shops, and roads have been swept away within hours, leaving families
without shelter or basic services. Rescue teams are operating in one of the most remote and
hard-to-reach parts of the country. They are digging through rubble by hand while facing the
constant risk of further flooding. IOM has deployed assessment teams and dispatched trucks carrying
life-saving relief supplies to affected communities.

# Exhibition Stand Design Company in Mumbai, India

With over 12 years in the exhibition industry, we ensure your brand is the star of the show by
creating eye-catching exhibition stands and overall look and feel which delivers the impression you
wish to give. SOL Brand Solutions doesn’t just stop at stand fabrication, we provide experiential
exhibition design & strategy that tells your brand story and helps you meet your business
objectives. From our Mumbai office, we have conceptualized and strategized over 1,000 such dedicated
booths at shows across India & around the world.

## **One-Stop Destination for Exhibition Stands**

Building a stand is more than having a framework built for exhibition. We provide brand experience
through exhibition stands. Strategic storytelling, creative direction, digital solutions and
sustainable design all come under one roof. Our team of 50+ utilizes a range of creative, technical
and production skills including creative direction, visualisation, design, event strategy,
fabrication and complete project management. With all expertise under one roof we ensure that your
exhibition stand is engaging, successful at generating leads and a premium brand experience above
the carpentry standard.

multiple zones such as meeting areas, product display areas, live demo areas and hospitality

flagship presentations at large scale expos in India and across the world.

### Industrial, Commercial, Municipal Pumps

Hayes Pump distributes an exemplary selection of [industrial, commercial and municipal pumps][89].
From Centrifugal to Positive Displacement, Sludge to Sanitary, Non-Metallic to Stainless Steel, we
can meet your needs.

### Packaged Pump Systems

Hayes Pump offers a variety of[ engineered pump systems][90] to meet your process system needs for
all markets and applications. Custom Packaged Skids, Fuel Oil Sets, Seal Water Systems, Chemical
Feed Systems, Mobile Pump Packages, Booster Systems.

### Service, Repair & Parts

We are a factory trained & authorized repair center for the manufacturers we represent. We have a
fleet of fully equipped field service vehicles for maintenance, installation, commissioning,
troubleshooting, and field repairs. Our dedicated team will find what you need. [Learn more.][91]

#### [Seals][117]

### Our Legacy

Hayes Pump is the Northeast’s largest industrial, commercial & municipal pump distributor with
offices from Maine to New Jersey. We are the oldest and largest stocking distributor of pumps in the
Northeast, representing 20 different suppliers of products used in transferring, metering, and
filtering fluids.

### Our Reputation

We’re proud of our continuous, long-standing relationships with these valued suppliers, and are
committed to maintaining our reputation as a “Best-in-Class Pump Distributor” every day and in
everything we do.

### Our Selection

Hayes Pump distributes the broadest line of pump products in the industry to suit virtually every
fluid handling need. We stock what is commonly used in our markets.

### Our Commitment

We will also stock for specific customer’s needs, saving them the expense and warehouse space to do
so. Our multi-million dollar inventory can easily support your operations.

### Industrial, Commercial, Municipal Pumps

Hayes Pump distributes an exemplary selection of [industrial, commercial and municipal pumps][89].
From Centrifugal to Positive Displacement, Sludge to Sanitary, Non-Metallic to Stainless Steel, we
can meet your needs.

### Packaged Pump Systems

Hayes Pump offers a variety of[ engineered pump systems][90] to meet your process system needs for
all markets and applications. Custom Packaged Skids, Fuel Oil Sets, Seal Water Systems, Chemical
Feed Systems, Mobile Pump Packages, Booster Systems.

### Service, Repair & Parts

We are a factory trained & authorized repair center for the manufacturers we represent. We have a
fleet of fully equipped field service vehicles for maintenance, installation, commissioning,
troubleshooting, and field repairs. Our dedicated team will find what you need. [Learn more.][91]

## Offering the Very Best in Flow Solutions

#### [Industrial Pumps][92]

[End Suction Pumps][93] [ANSI Pumps][94] [Self-Priming][95] [Rotary Gear][96]

#### [Pump Control Systems][97]

[Variable Frequency Drives][98] [Condition Monitoring][99] [Flow Control][100] [Flow
Monitoring][101]

#### [Fuel Oil Systems][102]

[Automatic Transfer][103] [Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)][104] [Thermopump][105] [NEMA 3R
Enclosures][106]

#### [Engineered Pump Systems][107]

[Seal Water Systems][108] [Chemical Feed Systems][109] [Booster Systems][110] [Mobile Pump
Systems][111]

#### [Inline Strainers][112]

[Metallic][113] [Non-Metallic][114] [In-Line][115] [Duplex][116]

#### [Seals][117]

[Cartridge Seals][118] [Slurry Seals][119] [Single Seals][120] [Labyrinth Seals][121]

### Our Legacy

Hayes Pump is the Northeast’s largest industrial, commercial & municipal pump distributor with
offices from Maine to New Jersey. We are the oldest and largest stocking distributor of pumps in the
Northeast, representing 20 different suppliers of products used in transferring, metering, and
filtering fluids.

### Our Reputation

We’re proud of our continuous, long-standing relationships with these valued suppliers, and are
committed to maintaining our reputation as a “Best-in-Class Pump Distributor” every day and in
everything we do.

### Our Selection

Hayes Pump distributes the broadest line of pump products in the industry to suit virtually every
fluid handling need. We stock what is commonly used in our markets.

### Our Commitment

We will also stock for specific customer’s needs, saving them the expense and warehouse space to do
so. Our multi-million dollar inventory can easily support your operations.

Die IFAT Munich ist der wichtigste Branchentreffpunkt und das Herz des größten internationalen
Netzwerks für Umwelttechnologien.

Im Mai 2026 präsentierten rund 3.400 Aussteller aus gut 60 Ländern und Regionen ihre Strategien und
Innovationen. Entdecken Sie zukunftsweisende Lösungen für Wasser, Recycling und Zirkularität.

## Pioneers from 1944 to a world leading modern environmental technology company in industrial air
## filtration

pollution control inside production facilities, protecting workers health and improving their
workplace. Nederman has continued to develop products and systems for a safe, clean and efficient
workplace, and today has the markets most complete range of products and services to protect people,
planet and products from harmful effects of industrial processes.

## 80 years of future shaping

In 1944 we started our clean air journey and today we have become one of the world's leading
environmental technology companies within air filtration and monitoring. We are more focused than
ever on future-proofing industries for a clean, bright future. It's our mission to shape the future
for clean air and we will continue this journey for many years to come.

[Read more about us][52]

## Industry Solutions

We offer the widest range of products and solutions for extraction and filtration of dust and
particles, welding fumes, exhaust fumes, oil mist, gases and combustible dust. Your industrial air
filtration expert!

## Our sustainability vision

Our sustainability vision is to create a world where industrial air pollution is no longer a threat
to human health and to our planet. We strive to achieve this through more sustainable and innovative
solutions that reduce emissions, promote energy and resource efficiency, and by supporting fairness
and inclusivity

[Read more about our sustainability work][62]

## Share our knowledge

### How to ensure effective at-source welding fume extraction using extraction arms for local
### exhaust ventilation

In many welding applications, at-source extraction is the most effective solution for capturing
fumes directly where they are generated. This article explains how extraction arms can be used
within local exhaust ventilation (LEV) systems to achieve efficient at-source welding fume
extraction, and which factors influence performance in practical use.

### When is an integrated extraction system in a welding torch the best choice for weld fume
### extraction?

Every welding process requires the right approach to fume extraction to ensure both efficiency and
safety. This article explains when an integrated extraction system in a welding torch, also known as
on-torch extraction, is the most effective solution for capturing fumes directly at the source.

## Filter status at your fingertips

Nederman Insight puts information at your fingertips, wherever you are. It not only provides you
with valuable data on how your filter is working, but helps to build a broader understanding of your
filtration system – its performance, maintenance needs, associated costs and potential improvements.

#### Here is how it works:
1. Sensors monitor conditions in the filtration system   
2. Data is securely uploaded to the cloud via an IoT gateway
3. You can easily read and interpret this data via our web-based user interface or dashboards

[Nederman myAir Connected Solutions][66]

## Pioneers from 1944 to a world leading modern environmental technology company in industrial air
## filtration

Founded by Philip Nederman in 1944, the company became a pioneer in developing solutions for air
pollution control inside production facilities, protecting workers health and improving their
workplace. Nederman has continued to develop products and systems for a safe, clean and efficient
workplace, and today has the markets most complete range of products and services to protect people,
planet and products from harmful effects of industrial processes.

complex and complicated one. A warm welcome to Nederman.

## A Global Restructuring Advisory Firm

A leading restructuring advisory firm needed a data import pipeline built for the scale of the
largest Chapter 11 cases. Nymbl delivered — replacing long, error-prone workflows with a
purpose-built AWS pipeline that normalizes case data from disparate sources, organizes claims and
complex debt structures, and prepares court ready filings.

No two bankruptcies are identical. They require various levels of data scrubbing, simultaneously
adapting to staggered data reception, and abiding by broad state and federal court mandates for
filings.

## What's in a logo?

**We're glad you asked.
**‍
*The 1% for the Planet logo is more than just a symbol of your commitment; it's a powerful tool for
brand differentiation.
*
According to [almost a decade of brand awareness studies][38], our logo comes with instant brand
recognition and boosts customers' decisions to purchase from member brands who certify their giving.

[Read about the power of our logo][39]

## Certified impact, made simple.

The 1% for the Planet model is accessible to businesses, credible for consumers and impactful for
people and the planet.

1.
[Commit][40][chevron]
[Pause video][Play video]
Commit to donating at least 1% of annual sales to environmental organizations
2.
[Give][41][chevron]
[Pause video][Play video]
Donate directly to one or more approved environmental organizations
3.
[Certify][42][chevron]
[Pause video][Play video]
Submit donation receipts and revenue documentation to certify as a 1% for the Planet member
4.
[Amplify][43][chevron]
[Pause video][Play video]
Use the 1% for the Planet network and certification to inspire businesses and individuals to take
action

[Pause video][Play video]
[Pause video][Play video]
[Pause video][Play video]

products and services.
[Explore certified businesses][44]

Apparel
[chevron]

> The capitalist ideal is that you grow a company and focus on making it as profitable as possible.
> Then, when you cash out, you become a philanthropist. We believe a company has a responsibility to
> do that all along–for the sake of the employees, for the sake of the planet.

“
YVON CHOUINARD, Founder, Patagonia & 1% for the Planet
Beverage
[chevron]

> Our 1% for the Planet partnership helps us fulfill our purpose of doing good through great beer.
> We consistently hear from customers that it matters to them and influences their decision-making
> in what companies they choose to support.

“
Colleen Croteau, COO of Maine Beer Company
[two hands with beers toasting]
[person in boots holding a peak design bag while walking]
Travel
[chevron]

> We joined 1% for the Planet to help hold ourselves accountable to our commitment to the planet. In
> addition to accountability, 1% for the Planet also vets organizations to ensure we support those

“

# Open Sustainable Technology[¶][129]

**A directory and analysis of the open source ecosystem in the areas of climate change, sustainable
energy, biodiversity and natural resources.**

*It is a miracle that our planet has developed a unique and stable environment for life in an
otherwise indifferent and hostile cosmos. Life has taken billions of years to build up the natural
resources we depend on, such as a protective atmosphere, fertile soil, stable weather, and clean
drinking water. As a movement to democratize technological development and knowledge creation, open
source has the potential to play a central part in preserving this stability. Open Sustainable
Technology's mission is to find, list, and share projects that preserve or analyze natural
ecosystems through open technology, methods, data, intelligence, knowledge or tools.*





Your contribution is essential to [keep this initative alive][130]. Create [a pull request][131] to
add a new project or [send an email][132] to give feedback, tips and ideas considering
[OpenSustain.tech][133]. All *Good First Issue* labelled issues of the listed projects will be
visible on [ClimateTriage.com][134]. All open source metadata is been provided to you by
[ecosyste.ms][135]. You can find a details description of the metadata we are collecting
[here][136]. **Would you like to help us find missing projects? Read our guidelines on: [How to
Identify Open Source Projects in Sustainability and Climate.][137]**

## Renewable Energy[¶][138]

> This category of tools targets the entire system design of renewable energy systems – from
> obtaining data, site selection, and material simulation to yield forecasting and quality control.
> While tools vary, the goal is to utilize better the energy provided by renewable energy sources.

### Photovoltaics and Solar Energy[¶][139]

> **What?** A method for generating and storing electricity directly from sunlight.
> 
> **How?** These tools help simulate, model, and forecast photovoltaic energy output, including
> optical and ray-tracing simulations; analyze and visualize system data; support quality control;
> and interface with solar hardware like panels, inverters, and batteries.
* [pvlib-python][140] - A set of documented functions for simulating the performance of photovoltaic
  energy systems.
* [pvfactors][141] - Open source view-factor model for diffuse shading and bifacial PV modeling.
* [gsee][142] - Global Solar Energy Estimator.
* [PVMismatch][143] - An explicit Python PV system IV & PV curve trace calculator which can also
  calculate mismatch.
* [rdtools][144] - An open source library to support reproducible technical analysis of time series
  data from photovoltaic energy systems.
* [Machine-Learning-for-Solar-Energy-Prediction][145] - Predict the power production of a solar
  panel farm from weather measurements using machine learning.
* [elpv-dataset][146] - A dataset of functional and defective solar cells extracted from EL images
  of solar modules.
* [feedinlib][147] - Contains implementations of photovoltaic models to calculate electricity
  generation from a PV installation based on given solar radiation. Furthermore it contains all
  necessary pre-calculations.
* [photovoltaic][148] - A Python library used in photovoltaics.
* [pvcaptest][149] - Collection of functions and Jupyter Notebooks to partially automate running a
  capacity test following ASTM E2848.
* [pvtrace][150] - Optical ray tracing for luminescent materials and spectral converter photovoltaic
  devices.
* [SolarPILOT][151] - Solar power tower layout and optimization tool.
* [solar-data-tools][152] - Data analysis tools for working with historical PV solar time-series
  data sets.
* [SolarPV-DER-simulation-utility][153] - Allows user to run dynamics simulations for solar
  photovoltaic distributed energy resource connected to a stiff voltage source or to an external
  program.
* [bifacial_radiance][154] - Toolkit for working with RADIANCE for the ray-trace modeling of
  Bifacial Photovoltaics.
* [autoXRD][155] - A Python package for automatic XRD pattern classification of thin-films, tweaked
  for small and class-imbalanced datasets.
* [BayesProcess][156] - A Python package for Physics informed Bayesian network inference using
  neural network surrogate model for matching process / variable / performance in solar cells.
* [solcore5][157] - A multi-scale, Python-based library for the modeling of solar cells and
  semiconductor materials.
* [solax][158] - Read energy usage data from the real-time API on Solax solar inverters.
* [bifacialvf][159] - Bifacial PV View Factor model for system performance calculation.
* [solaR][160] - Allows for reproducible research both for photovoltaics systems performance and
  solar radiation.
* [SolarTherm][161] - Solar thermal power/fuel station performance simulation and optimization using
  Modelica.
* [LibreSolar][162] - Firmware for LibreSolar BMS boards based on bq769x0 or ISL94202.
* [Charge Controller Firmware][163] - Firmware for LibreSolar MPPT/PWM charge controllers.
* [pvoutput][164] - Python code for downloading PV data from PVOutput.org.
* [solarpy][165] - This package aims to provide a reliable solar radiation model, mainly based on
  the work of Duffie, J.A., and Beckman, W. A., 1974, 'Solar energy thermal processes'.
* [solariot][166] - Leverage your IoT enabled Solar PV Inverter to stream your solar energy usage
  data to a real time dashboard.
* [pvanalytics][167] - Quality control, filtering, feature labeling, and other tools for working
  with data from photovoltaic energy systems.
* [IonMonger][168] - A free and fast perovskite solar cell simulator with coupled ion vacancy and
  charge carrier dynamics in one dimension.
* [rayflare][169] - Provide a flexible, user-friendly Python environment to model complex optical
  stacks, with a focus on solar cells.
* [pv-terms][170] - Contains nomenclature for PV-relevant terms that are used in modeling and data
  analysis for PV systems.
* [StatisticalClearSky][171] - Statistical estimation of a clear sky signal from PV system power
  data.
* [Photovoltaic_Fault_Detector][172] - Model-definition is a deep learning application for fault
  detection in photovoltaic plants.
* [nasapower][173] - Aims to make it quick and easy to automate downloading NASA-POWER global
  meteorology, surface solar energy and climatology data in your R session as a tidy data frame
  tibble object for analysis and use in modeling or other purposes.
* [pvcompare][174] - A model for comparing the benefits of different PV technologies in a specified
  local energy system in different energy supply scenarios.
* [SolTrace][175] - A software tool developed at NREL to model concentrating solar power (CSP)
  systems and analyze their optical performance.

# Open Sustainable Technology[¶][129]

**A directory and analysis of the open source ecosystem in the areas of climate change, sustainable
energy, biodiversity and natural resources.**

*It is a miracle that our planet has developed a unique and stable environment for life in an
otherwise indifferent and hostile cosmos. Life has taken billions of years to build up the natural
resources we depend on, such as a protective atmosphere, fertile soil, stable weather, and clean
drinking water. As a movement to democratize technological development and knowledge creation, open
source has the potential to play a central part in preserving this stability. Open Sustainable
Technology's mission is to find, list, and share projects that preserve or analyze natural
ecosystems through open technology, methods, data, intelligence, knowledge or tools.*





Your contribution is essential to [keep this initative alive][130]. Create [a pull request][131] to
add a new project or [send an email][132] to give feedback, tips and ideas considering
[OpenSustain.tech][133]. All *Good First Issue* labelled issues of the listed projects will be
visible on [ClimateTriage.com][134]. All open source metadata is been provided to you by
[ecosyste.ms][135]. You can find a details description of the metadata we are collecting
[here][136]. **Would you like to help us find missing projects? Read our guidelines on: [How to
Identify Open Source Projects in Sustainability and Climate.][137]**

## Renewable Energy[¶][138]

> This category of tools targets the entire system design of renewable energy systems – from
> obtaining data, site selection, and material simulation to yield forecasting and quality control.
> While tools vary, the goal is to utilize better the energy provided by renewable energy sources.

### Photovoltaics and Solar Energy[¶][139]

> **What?** A method for generating and storing electricity directly from sunlight.
> 
> **How?** These tools help simulate, model, and forecast photovoltaic energy output, including
> optical and ray-tracing simulations; analyze and visualize system data; support quality control;
> and interface with solar hardware like panels, inverters, and batteries.
* [pvlib-python][140] - A set of documented functions for simulating the performance of photovoltaic
  energy systems.
* [pvfactors][141] - Open source view-factor model for diffuse shading and bifacial PV modeling.
* [gsee][142] - Global Solar Energy Estimator.
* [PVMismatch][143] - An explicit Python PV system IV & PV curve trace calculator which can also
  calculate mismatch.
* [rdtools][144] - An open source library to support reproducible technical analysis of time series
  data from photovoltaic energy systems.
* [Machine-Learning-for-Solar-Energy-Prediction][145] - Predict the power production of a solar
  panel farm from weather measurements using machine learning.
* [elpv-dataset][146] - A dataset of functional and defective solar cells extracted from EL images
  of solar modules.
* [feedinlib][147] - Contains implementations of photovoltaic models to calculate electricity
  generation from a PV installation based on given solar radiation. Furthermore it contains all
  necessary pre-calculations.
* [photovoltaic][148] - A Python library used in photovoltaics.
* [pvcaptest][149] - Collection of functions and Jupyter Notebooks to partially automate running a
  capacity test following ASTM E2848.
* [pvtrace][150] - Optical ray tracing for luminescent materials and spectral converter photovoltaic
  devices.
* [SolarPILOT][151] - Solar power tower layout and optimization tool.
* [solar-data-tools][152] - Data analysis tools for working with historical PV solar time-series
  data sets.
* [SolarPV-DER-simulation-utility][153] - Allows user to run dynamics simulations for solar
  photovoltaic distributed energy resource connected to a stiff voltage source or to an external
  program.
* [bifacial_radiance][154] - Toolkit for working with RADIANCE for the ray-trace modeling of
  Bifacial Photovoltaics.
* [autoXRD][155] - A Python package for automatic XRD pattern classification of thin-films, tweaked
  for small and class-imbalanced datasets.
* [BayesProcess][156] - A Python package for Physics informed Bayesian network inference using
  neural network surrogate model for matching process / variable / performance in solar cells.
* [solcore5][157] - A multi-scale, Python-based library for the modeling of solar cells and
  semiconductor materials.
* [solax][158] - Read energy usage data from the real-time API on Solax solar inverters.
* [bifacialvf][159] - Bifacial PV View Factor model for system performance calculation.
* [solaR][160] - Allows for reproducible research both for photovoltaics systems performance and
  solar radiation.
* [SolarTherm][161] - Solar thermal power/fuel station performance simulation and optimization using
  Modelica.
* [LibreSolar][162] - Firmware for LibreSolar BMS boards based on bq769x0 or ISL94202.
* [Charge Controller Firmware][163] - Firmware for LibreSolar MPPT/PWM charge controllers.
* [pvoutput][164] - Python code for downloading PV data from PVOutput.org.
* [solarpy][165] - This package aims to provide a reliable solar radiation model, mainly based on
  the work of Duffie, J.A., and Beckman, W. A., 1974, 'Solar energy thermal processes'.
* [solariot][166] - Leverage your IoT enabled Solar PV Inverter to stream your solar energy usage
  data to a real time dashboard.
* [pvanalytics][167] - Quality control, filtering, feature labeling, and other tools for working
  with data from photovoltaic energy systems.
* [IonMonger][168] - A free and fast perovskite solar cell simulator with coupled ion vacancy and
  charge carrier dynamics in one dimension.
* [rayflare][169] - Provide a flexible, user-friendly Python environment to model complex optical
  stacks, with a focus on solar cells.
* [pv-terms][170] - Contains nomenclature for PV-relevant terms that are used in modeling and data
  analysis for PV systems.
* [StatisticalClearSky][171] - Statistical estimation of a clear sky signal from PV system power
  data.
* [Photovoltaic_Fault_Detector][172] - Model-definition is a deep learning application for fault
  detection in photovoltaic plants.
* [nasapower][173] - Aims to make it quick and easy to automate downloading NASA-POWER global
  meteorology, surface solar energy and climatology data in your R session as a tidy data frame
  tibble object for analysis and use in modeling or other purposes.
* [pvcompare][174] - A model for comparing the benefits of different PV technologies in a specified
  local energy system in different energy supply scenarios.
* [SolTrace][175] - A software tool developed at NREL to model concentrating solar power (CSP)
  systems and analyze their optical performance.
* [CarrierCapture.jl][176] - A set of codes to compute

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

# About Saddleback Environmental

***Saddleback Environmental Equipment, Inc.*** functions primarily as an equipment manufacturers'
representative, distributor, technical service and "specialty" design engineering firm. The
companies we represent are the industry's leading suppliers of equipment for water treatment,
wastewater treatment, water reuse, odor control and biosolids handling, dewatering and Class A
remediation. Our territory of coverage includes California, Arizona and Nevada.



***Experience:*** Founded in May 2002, our sales staff includes three experienced sales engineers.
In addition, we have a full time factory trained technician capable of performing mechanical
equipment start-up and training, so that service can be offered locally to our customers. Combined,
we have over 50 years experience in marketing and sales, manufacturing, equipment servicing and
startup, environmental process design, civil and mechanical design and construction management.



***Capabilities:*** Our in-depth knowledge of the products we sell enables us to select the latest
state-of-the-art equipment to compliment engineered process designs. The equipment we offer
represent not only the best available technology, but are cost effective to operate and maintain. We
specialize in problem solving, using a variety of innovative and creative approaches. We are in the
forefront offering new energy efficient technologies, including exclusive waste-heat to power
products. Our firm has received numerous sales and engineering awards. In partnership with selected
contractors, we have successfully completed and currently provide the capability to perform complete
turnkey design/build projects. Our solid financial background allows our firm to act as a
distributor/supplier. This gives us added flexibility in bidding and securing business in our
industry.



***Offices:*** Our offices are located throughout California and in Arizona. Our corporate office is
located in Encintas, CA. 

#### Our Services
* Equipment sales
* Process and mechanical equipment design assistance
* Energy savings and present worth analysis reports
* Equipment start-up and training
* Factory trained equipment servicing
* Equipment for pilot testing
* Parts sales
* Equipment rental

# Skybrokers

## All-in-one reseller of new and used satellite equipment

Skybrokers is your trusted all-in-one reseller of new and used satellite equipment, serving
customers worldwide with complete and cost-effective solutions. As a true one-stop-shop, we supply
**antennas**, **RF-equipment**, **spare parts**, and **full ground station systems** for teleport,
broadcast, government, and enterprise markets. Our extensive global network for buying and selling
enables fast sourcing and reliable availability. Customers benefit from our fast response times,
dependable service, and competitive pricing to reduce CAPEX. From single components to complete
installations, Skybrokers delivers professional turnkey solutions tailored to your project needs.

[Rotating globe]

## Projects around the globe

Since its inception, Skybrokers has successfully completed a wide range of antenna projects
worldwide, supporting customers across every region of the globe. From de-installation and
refurbishment to transportation, installation, and full commissioning, our experienced team has
delivered reliable solutions for teleport operators, broadcasters, governments, and satellite
service providers. Each completed project reflects our commitment to quality, technical expertise,
and dependable execution in the global satellite ground station industry.

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]
[Das Bild zeigt zwei Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion mit einer Wärmepumpe]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Mitarbeiter bei der Montage in der Produktionsstätte Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt eine Familie und eine Wärmepumpe.]
[Das Bild zeigt das Hauptgebäude in Allendorf (Eder).]
Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]
  [Das Bild zeigt digitale Dienste auf einem Smartphone für die Energiekontrolle in Häusern.]

### Über Viessmann Climate Solutions

1917 als Heiztechnik-Hersteller gegründet, ist Viessmann Climate Solutions heute ein weltweit
führender Anbieter für effiziente und systemische Klima- (Wärme, Wasser- und Luftqualität) und
erneuerbare Energielösungen. Das integrierte Viessmann Climate Solutions Portfolio verbindet
Produkte und Systeme über digitale Plattformen und Dienstleistungen nahtlos und schafft so ein
sicheres und verlässliches Wohlfühlklima für die Nutzer:innen. Viessmann Climate Solutions ist Teil
der Carrier Global Corporation, einem weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Klima- und
Energielösungen.

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]
[Das Bild zeigt zwei Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion mit einer Wärmepumpe]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Mitarbeiter bei der Montage in der Produktionsstätte Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt eine Familie und eine Wärmepumpe.]
[Das Bild zeigt das Hauptgebäude in Allendorf (Eder).]
Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]

  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr

Verantwortung zu übernehmen und im Team zu denken, sind wesentliche Bestandteile unserer

unterstützen wir Athleten, Funktionäre sowie Verbände und pflegen enge Partnerschaften.

### Wir sind international

Unser regionaler Hauptsitz ist Allendorf (Eder) in Nordhessen aber wir sind global aktiv. Unsere

Versorgung mit Wärme, Kälte, Luft und Energie.
